previous_statement: Base case, with dependencies explicit: node 1.1 gives r_-(e)<1/8, while the root hypothesis is exactly a_1>=1/4. Hence a_1>r_-(e). Applying the dichotomy proved in node 1.2 at n=1, the alternative a_1<=r_-(e) is impossible, so a_1>=r_+(e).
new_statement: Base reduction without an empty infimum: either S_P={0}, in which case the root estimate holds at every matrix level without defining any a_m, or S_P!={0}, in which case a_1 is a finite nonnegative real and the root lower-modulus hypothesis together with nodes 1.1 and 1.2 implies a_1>=r_+(e).
